message.content:
Assuming \(x > 0\),

\[
\log(x**3) = 3 \cdot \log(x)
\]

So,

\[
\int -3 \cdot \log(x**3)\,dx
= \int -3 \cdot (3 \cdot \log(x))\,dx
= -9 \cdot \int \log(x)\,dx
\]

Using

\[
\int \log(x)\,dx = x \cdot \log(x) - x
\]

we get

\[
-9 \cdot (x \cdot \log(x) - x) + C
= -9 \cdot x \cdot \log(x) + 9 \cdot x + C
\]

<answer>-9*x*log(x) + 9*x + C</answer>
